architecture.mechanism: Electromagnetic field‑tuned scaling pathways that alter CaCO3 and CaSO4·2H2O nucleation and growth
architecture.intervention: Apply a continuous low‑frequency electromagnetic field to the feed water or membrane module to actively modify the scaling pathways and prevent crystal formation
architecture.expected_effect: Permeate flux remains above 85 % of start‑of‑life for 12 months with no chemical antiscalant, acid injection, and at fixed 75 % recovery
architecture.falsification_test: Run a 12‑month pilot where one skid operates with the electromagnetic field and a matched control skid runs without; measure permeate flux decline and perform post‑mortem SEM analysis. If flux falls below 85 % of initial within 12 months in either skid, the mechanism is falsified
